title: 12 Best Night Markets in Cartagena
description: Discover Cartagena's vibrant night markets and street food scene! From traditional fritters in Getsemaní to fresh seafood in Bocagrande, find the best spots for authentic flavors, budget-friendly eats, and unique cultural experiences after dark. Your guide to Cartagena's top evening culinary adventures.

places.name: Plaza de la Trinidad
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Arepa con Huevo from a street vendor, followed by a 'Mojarra Frita' (fried fish) or a 'Chuzo de Carne' (meat skewer).

places.name: Portal de los Dulces & Plaza de los Coches
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Cocada (coconut candy), Enyucado (yuca cake), or a refreshing 'Cholado' (fruit, shaved ice, condensed milk).

places.name: Parque Bolívar Street Food
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A freshly squeezed 'Jugo de Corozo' (corozo juice) or 'Níspero' (loquat fruit) and an 'Oblea' generously filled with Arequipe and cheese.

places.name: Avenida Venezuela Street Food
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A 'Perro Caliente con todo' (hot dog with all the toppings like crushed potato chips, pink sauce, pineapple sauce) or a 'Hamburguesa Colombiana'.

places.name: Bocagrande Boardwalk Vendors
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A fresh 'Ceviche de Camarón' (shrimp ceviche) in a cup, or a cold 'Agua de Coco' (coconut water) paired with an 'Oblea'.

places.name: Fritanga de Bazurto (Perimeter Stalls)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A whole 'Mojarra Frita' with 'Arroz con Coco' (coconut rice) and 'Patacones' (fried plantain).

places.name: Calle de la Media Luna Vendors
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A 'Kibbeh' (Middle Eastern inspired fried bulgur snack, popular in coastal Colombia) or a 'Papa Rellena' (stuffed potato).

places.name: Plaza de San Diego Street Food
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A 'Mango Biche' (green mango with salt, lemon, and pepper) or a handcrafted cocktail from a pop-up bar cart.

places.name: Las Bóvedas Artisanal Food Stalls
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A refreshing 'Limonada de Coco' (coconut lemonade) or a small bag of roasted cashews from a vendor.

places.name: Mercado de San Pedro Claver (Vendors)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A cup of mixed tropical fruit salad with condensed milk or a simple 'Arepa con Queso'.

places.name: El Laguito Promenade Vendors
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A 'Coctel de Camarones' (shrimp cocktail) served in a cup with crackers, or a 'Raspao' (shaved ice with syrup).

places.name: Parque Fernández de Madrid
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A freshly fried 'Empanada de Carne' (beef empanada) and a cold 'Postobón' soda.
